name: installed-entry
status: Input profile; applications are recorded separately per experiment. Historical bare-host results and the reasoning-budget rerun do not use this profile.
purpose: Represent the AEGIS entry instructions delivered by an installed root instruction file, while evaluating frame/validate/task prompt changes.

bootstrap.delivery: Initial host instruction context, before the scenario user request; preserve existing constrained-host tool instructions.

fixed_controls.reasoning_budget_source: User-set in LM Studio; inspect actual usage
fixed_controls.reasoning_history: Current content/tool_calls replay, recorded as a shared limitation

prompt_exposure: Full contract, active stage and required templates remain repository reads, as in the installed workflow; record actual reads rather than assuming them.
comparison_rule: Run a fresh baseline and candidate under this same entry profile. Historical bare-host scores are not controls for prompt improvements. Each payload supplies its own root digest, as init installs it from that payload, so the digest varies with the payload under test and is recorded, not compared; freeze the model configuration and the host contract across the pair.
separate_measurements: Reviewed semantic compliance and unsupported inferences
known_boundary: Synthetic tools and verifier are a constrained test environment, not a complete native-agent benchmark. Supplying the root digest alone does not prove equivalent native behavior.
